payload.title: Sponsorship catalogue and switch, with topic matching from map concepts
payload.description: web/sponsorship.json holds six solutions with the design's copy and the real landing URLs: cyclotron.anth.us, aurit.us, chattic.us, anth.us/platform/biblicus/, p.apyr.us and anth.us/ai-solutions/. 'Talk to Anthus' goes to anth.us/engage/?solution=<Name>. enabled stays false until Ryan approves. Matching picks a solution from the page's concepts, with a generic fallback; no solution appears twice on a page.
